identity.description: An unprivileged user process opens a registry hive to establish persistence. Cortex should detect the registry hive access by a non-system process. The attack involves using reg.exe to open a hive file directly.

biocs.name: Unprivileged Process Opened Registry Hive
biocs.description: Detection of an unprivileged process opening a registry hive file directly, bypassing normal registry access mechanisms.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'reg.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'SOFTWARE' and action_file_path contains 'System32' and action_file_path contains 'config'

abiocs.name: Unprivileged Process Opens Registry Hive
